configurationAdequacy.headroomArgument: Declared limits are adequate for the horizon defined in requirements/client-requirements.md § 1 (100-300 turns, up to 8M tokens/trajectory): contextWindowTokens=200000 covers observed rollout envelopes; maxOutputTokens=16000 covers observed outputs; wallClockTimeoutSeconds=5400 (90min) exceeds the 43min p95 observed in the pyjwt signed pilot by 2.1x; toolCallCap=300 matches § 1's 100-300 target; sandbox 2vCPU/8GB is the container spec every recorded rollout ran under. Adequacy for systemPromptDigest is DEFERRED per the harness-owned-prompt gap: the harness is a passthrough proxy to the agent CLI; system-prompt bytes are constructed at runtime by claude-code / codex and are not stable across agent CLI upgrades. Adequacy for this dimension resumes only after a harness-owned system-prompt overlay is introduced and its bytes are frozen, OR after the agent CLI version is pinned and its emitted system-prompt bytes are captured and digested.
